state_vocabulary.MEASURED: a signed card in the measured state backs the cell
state_vocabulary.UNMEASURED: NOT measured — no signed card; may be unaffordable, missing, or never run
state_vocabulary.INDEXED: discovered in a corpus; NOT measured
state_vocabulary.STAGED: landed and signed but not committed to a root; NOT measured

note: model-behaviour coverage only. This is NOT a safety certification and NOT a regulatory verdict.

combined.caveat: Two disjoint populations on different axis vocabularies. The sum is reported for coverage arithmetic only; the two must never be presented as one homogeneous matrix.
